name: slab-tasks
description: Your Slab Tasks to-do list: add tasks with a date and time, list, update and complete them, and turn meeting notes into to-dos.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Slab Tasks desktop app on this PC. Ask things like "add a task to send the deck to Priya on Friday at 3pm" or "what's due today?". Tasks Claude adds show up in the app straight away, tagged CLAUDE. Works with meeting-notes connectors such as Wispr Flow to add only your own action items.

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description: Add tasks, optionally with a due date and time, or from a meeting

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List today's, upcoming, all or finished tasks

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's title, notes, date, time or colour, or complete it

tools.name: check_meetings
tools.description: Tell which meetings were already turned into tasks

tools.name: mark_meetings_processed
tools.description: Record meetings that had no tasks for you

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Scheduled runs: the window of meetings to read

tools.name: finish_run
tools.description: Scheduled runs: save where the next run starts

prompts.name: tasks_from_meetings
prompts.description: Read meeting notes and add your action items
prompts.text: Create Slab Tasks to-dos from my meetings (${arguments.when}).

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: Your name as it appears in meetings, so Claude only adds your own action items.

since.title: Ignore meetings before
since.description: Optional ISO time (e.g. 2026-10-29T21:00:00Z). Meetings that started earlier are never turned into tasks automatically.
